data.name: Variant Channeling - Bravery/Valor
data.description: Heal - Creatures affected by fear may attempt another saving throw and receive a +%1 channel bonus on the roll. A creature unaffected by fear gains a +%1 channel bonus to its Armor Class until the end of your next turn and on its attack roll if it makes a charge attack before your next turn. Harm - This works like a standard channel (not halved).|ChannelModifier
